The climate in Antalya

Antalya is about 53 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 36°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 6°C. Around 990 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in January (about 226 mm). The highest temperature in Antalya in 2015–2024 was 44°C (23 July 2023) and the lowest −2°C (8 January 2015).

Best time to visit Antalya

The most pleasant weather in Antalya is usually in April, May, October and November: average highs are between 21°C and 27°C, with up to 8 days of rain a month. In June, July, August and September it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
